description: This PHP source file defines a class for upgrading and migrating database schemas and configurations for the Revive Adserver, specifically related to the openads upgrade process for version 2.3.33-beta-rc4.

classes.name: OA_UpgradePrescript_2_3_33
classes.description: A class responsible for upgrading the database schema and configuration files during the openads upgrade process for version 2.3.33-beta-rc4.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the upgrade process, including database schema alteration and configuration migration.

methods.name: alterDatabaseActionTable
methods.description: Alters the database action table schema if necessary.

methods.name: _getLatestDatabaseActionSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the latest database schema definition for the database_action table.

methods.name: migratePluginsIniConfigs
methods.description: Renames plugin configuration files from *.ini to *.php.
